services.name: tent site
services.desc: As far as we know, Fancy Gap Cabins and Campground is the only full service campground on the Blue Ridge Parkway. We are located just south of Fancy Gap, Virginia close to the Virginia-North Carolina line. We specialize in giving our guests a place to unplug, refresh and relax with family and friends. With RV sites, camping cabins, tents sites and a motel, everyone can find a place to stay and find lots to do./ or choose to do nothing at all. Relaxing is the number one activity at Fancy Gap Cabins and Campground. The RV and tent sites have space for camping chairs and picnic tables to spread out the snacks. Three of our sites have decks that provide additional outdoor space to cook, play

services.name: Camping Cabins
services.desc: Cabin 1, like all of our camping cabins, gives you a camping experience without having to pack all of the equipment. Inside cabin 1, shows how our cabins let you you camp in comfort with a queen bed (includes bedding), microwave, minifridge, table, chairs, lamp, Wi-Fi and coffee maker with coffee packs, cups, sugar and creamer. Cabin 2. Each camping cabin includes an outdoor area with a fire pit, picnic table and charcoal grill. Water hydrants are outside as well. All the cabins comfortably sleep 2 on the queen bed. services.name: Fishing and Hunting
services.desc: Several fishing and hunting areas are close to Fancy Gap Cabins and Campground. More and more of our guests are staying with us and enjoying our proximity to wildlife areas, lakes and creeks. Located in Woodlawn, which is between 1-77 and Galax, Crooked Creek Wildlife Area offers fee fishing in six miles of regularly stocked trout streams. The Wildlife Management Area also has over 1,700 acres of forest and fields that are good for hiking, hunting, and wildlife viewing. To reach Crooked Creek Fee Fishing Area, from FGCC, take I-77 north to exit 14. Go left off the exit onto Rt 58 and drive 3.8 miles to Forest Oak Road/Rt 620.
